summary: Cuentas Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Power-as-a-Service and Colocation Services Agreement with Power Upp USA, Inc. dated September 20, 2026, covering up to ten container sets at 2.4 MW each (24.0 MW aggregate) at a Seminole, Texas site, hosting roughly 4,200 company-owned ASIC miners staged one set per 90 days. One-time charges are $500,000 per container set plus $90,000 security deposit allocation per set, implying up to $5.0 million and $900,000 respectively, with energy at $0.05 per kWh, CPI escalators, and colocation at 5% of gross mining revenues plus $2,500 monthly. No special-situation event, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed.
